verdict.rationale: Rev AI is an API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no doc in the pack mentions a machine-readable spec. The llms.txt index and the MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
